title: Haye Rulgayi Mahendi
body:

Haey Rul Gaei Mehndi, Haey Rul Gaei Mehndi
Haey Rul Gaei Mehndi, Haey Rul Gaei Mehndi
<<DIVIDER>>
Raitaanch Dul Gaei, Mityaanch Rul Gaei, Maa Nu Rawavay, Qasim Di Mehndi.
Kubra Da Baba Chadar Vicha Kay, Chun Chun Kay Pavay, Qasim Di Mehndi.
Maqtal Cho Syed Ey Vain Paaya, Kallah Hay Nana Zahra Da Jayaa, Kausar Kanaaray Mairay Turgay Saray, Kayra Uthavay Qasim Di Mehndi.
Kuj Mehndi Gohray Summach Lay Gay, Kuj Eyday Tukray Maqtalch Ray Gay, Syed Musafir Qasim Di Maa Ton, Keewain Lukaa Vay Qasim Di Mehndi.
Putraan Nu Lokon Sehraych Laa O, Qasim Di Pehlaa Majalis Kara O, Banray Nu Aakho Shagnaa Day Vailay, O Kad Nah Javay Qasim Di Mehndi.
Khaiyyam Andar Jadon Mehndi Aayi, Banray Di Maa Nay Sir Khaak Paayi, Banree Da Baba Bheni Bulaakay, Ro Ro Vakhaa Vay Qasim Di Mehndi.
Pehra Laga Tha Darya Pe Har Jaa, Pyasa Tha Kunbaa Pani Nhi Tha, Pani Ke Badlay Ashkon Se Goondhi, Madar Ne Haey Qasim Di Mehndi.
Tukray Huway Yu Armaan Dil Ke, Ankhon Se Uski Kyun Khoon Na Barsay, Sajjad Aaey Hain Shaam Logon, Dil Mein Basaey Qasim Ki Mehndi.
Farwa Ke Aansu Deinge Zamanat, Poori Na Hogi Kis Trha Mannat, Kubra Ke Sadqay Jab Koi Beti, Jab Bhi Uthaey Qasim Ki Mehndi.
Tauqeer O Dy Toh Sain Raazi, Mazloom-e-Karbal Di Bhain Raazi
Qasim Di Turbat Dil Vich Waasa Kay, Jeyra Uthavay Qasim Di Mehndi.
